adopted_replan.reason: C8 requires an adopted re-plan to be made durable as a repair request before routing it to planning; an executed-open predecessor is not integrated.

mixed_none_blocked.reason: The superagent WAITING FOR RUN branch gives an unresolved code PR precedence over none; C9 also treats an open PR as BLOCKED.

closeout_repair.reason: C6 targets a valid repair requested row only for planning and skips its predecessor for execution until C8 publishes the successor.

merged.reason: C9 accepts a closed leaf only with verified merged PR, merge commit on main, and tracked closeout.

declined.reason: C9 accepts an authorized declined disposition with its recorded reason and PR disposition as a terminal obligation.

fresh_tick.reason: C8 replay reconciliation converts the adopted log decision with no tree edit into the durable repair request before dispatch.

successor.reason: After C8 publication, the active successor is an ordinary ready leaf for execution; predecessor history remains subject to later disposition verification.

stale_ancestor.reason: C9 must visit active child links despite a closed ancestor; the hidden executed-open leaf is a BLOCKED obligation, which routes to the decision ladder.

missing_evidence.reason: C9 requires verified integration evidence; an unqueryable PR and unverifiable main integration are BLOCKED, never optimistic completion.

late_closeout.reason: C7's active-plan guard says a predecessor closeout must not advance a row whose active Plan points to a successor.

replay.reason: C8 replay reuses a named successor when the active link agrees; it must neither reset the row nor create another successor.

hidden_ready.reason: C9 treats ordinary ready work hidden below a closed ancestor as BLOCKED until authorized reconciliation restores reachability.

second_repair.reason: C8 treats the verified P0 to P1 to P2 chain as historical succession; only the latest unresolved request matters, and P2 is the active execution leaf.

declined_repair.reason: C8 says an authorized declined repair with matching evidence is settled and must not reopen even if its old successor field was pending.

direct_merge.reason: C9 accepts direct/no-PR work when its recorded integration commit is verified on local main and its closeout is tracked.

closed_pr.reason: C9 classifies a closed-but-unmerged PR with no authorized disposition or successor as BLOCKED, then the supervisor uses the decision ladder.
